spells/prismatic-mist-2975.name: Prismatic Mist
spells/prismatic-mist-2975.effectSummary: Creates a thin 30-foot-radius multihued mist for 1 minute per caster level. It does not obscure vision or provide concealment. Each round a creature begins its turn in the mist, or whenever it enters the mist during its turn, roll 1d8: 1 red deals 1d4 fire damage; 2 orange deals 1d6 acid damage; 3 yellow deals 1d8 electricity damage; 4 green deals 1d4 Strength damage with a Fortitude save to negate; 5 blue slows the creature for 1 round with a Will save to negate; 6 indigo causes lesser confusion for 1 round with a Will save to negate and is mind-affecting; 7 violet dazes for 1 round with a Will save to negate; 8 means the creature is at a junction of two colors, so roll twice more and apply both results, rerolling any further 8s. Spell resistance does not apply.
tables: Lesser confusion for 1 round (Will negates, mind-affecting)
the junction of two colors; roll twice more, ignoring any "8" results

spells/prismatic-ray-508.name: Prismatic Ray
spells/prismatic-ray-508.effectSummary: Fires one ray requiring a ranged touch attack. On a hit, a creature with 6 Hit Dice or fewer is blinded for 2d4 rounds in addition to one randomly determined effect from 1d6: 1 red deals 20 fire damage (Reflex half); 2 orange deals 40 acid damage (Reflex half); 3 yellow deals 80 electricity damage (Reflex half); 4 green kills by poison, but a successful Fortitude save instead deals 1d6 Constitution damage; 5 blue turns the target to stone unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save; 6 indigo causes permanent insanity, functioning as continuous confusion, unless it succeeds on a Will save.
tables: Poison (Kills; Fortitude partial, take 1d6 Con damage instead)

spells/prismatic-spray-2640.name: Prismatic Spray
spells/prismatic-spray-2640.effectSummary: Fills the 60-foot cone with seven multicolored beams. Creatures in the area with 8 Hit Dice or fewer are automatically blinded for 2d4 rounds. Every creature in the area is also struck by one or more randomly determined beam effects from 1d8: 1 red deals 20 fire damage (Reflex half); 2 orange deals 40 acid damage (Reflex half); 3 yellow deals 80 electricity damage (Reflex half); 4 green kills by poison, but a successful Fortitude save instead deals 1d6 Constitution damage; 5 blue turns the creature to stone unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save; 6 indigo causes permanent insanity, functioning as continuous confusion, unless it succeeds on a Will save; 7 violet sends the creature to another plane unless it succeeds on a Will save; 8 strikes the creature with two rays, rolling twice more and ignoring further 8s.
